pill.desc: colorless, clear to slightly opalescent solution in a single-dose vial

tell: An α4-integrin antibody dispensed only through registered infusion centers, under a boxed PML warning.

clues.text: Clearance rises with body weight, but less than proportionally, and persistent anti-drug antibodies raise it about 3-fold. Renal or hepatic insufficiency has not been studied.
A recombinant, humanized protein made in murine myeloma cells, with a molecular weight of 149 kilodaltons.
Approved under a BLA as a single-dose 300 mg/15 mL vial for dilution, dosed every four weeks.

Boxed warning for progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy, a viral brain infection often fatal or severely disabling. Contraindicated in PML and prior hypersensitivity; headache and fatigue are most common.
Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis as monotherapy, and moderately to severely active Crohn's disease.
Binds α4β1 and α4β7 integrins on all leukocytes except neutrophils, blocking their adhesion and migration into inflamed tissue.
The generic name begins with N and has eleven letters.
